record.question: In a slider-crank mechanism, the velocity of piston becomes maximum when
options: Crank and connecting rod are in line with each other
Crank is perpendicular to the line of stroke of the piston
Crank and connecting rod are perpendicular
Crank is 1200 with the line of stroke
record.explanation: Neglecting obliquity, piston velocity is v = w r sin(theta), which is maximum when the crank is perpendicular to the line of stroke.
